rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ReadyOrAI performs static code analysis across nine quality categories without API keys or external calls. It supports deep AST-based analysis for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust, with regex-based checks for additional languages. Features include CLI and MCP interfaces, SARIF export for GitHub Code Scanning, watch mode for continuous analysis, and inline comment suppression for specific warnings.
